friendly_name: mission-shell: shared Svelte 5 shell over the MissionStatusClient port
landed_note: merged_commit and the accept fields record the pre-landing consolidation on feat/mission-shell-18, which main does not contain because PR #34 was squash-merged. landed_commit is the commit on main that holds the mission. The acceptance matrix was written before the pre-merge squad folds and was refreshed after the landing.
purpose_context: The mission screens and the MissionStatusClient port exist, but no host renders the screens with real navigation and live data. This mission builds the shared Svelte shell both hosts mount: routing and layout around the screens, state, the mapping from screen intents to reads and host actions, the refresh policy driven by the change stream, connection banners, and how the dashboard treats desktop-only intents. It touches no I/O and changes neither the port nor the screens. Tracked as mission-ui issue 18 under epic 16.
purpose_tldr: Give Kitty Desktop and Kitty Dashboard one shared shell that routes between the mission screens, keeps their data current from the change stream, and shows clearly when the service is connecting, reconnecting or unavailable.
